intro.text: A young Luthadel noble, about Vin's age.

items.text: Asked Valette Renoux to dance at Keep Elariel; she accepted, hoping to make Elend ask her. Stiffly formal, a poor dancer and wary of her ties to Elend, he relaxed once she called Elend a family friend. He knew little about Elend, flirted with her, and let slip that Shan Elariel had been gossiping about her. Afterwards he talked about her with his friends, and one of them soon asked her to dance.
